page.layout: One column of names, each group headed by a year printed in the left margin beside the column. Running head above the column. Gathering signature at the foot.; One column of text on the right of a vertical rule; the left margin is partly cut away, with one margin word at the bottom left.

main_text.p: Moritur Regn. Prædinius, (in pago Winsem natus,) hoc anno, die Martis, post horam decimam sepultus die Jovis XVIII. Aprîl. Anno ætatis suæ LI.
Ordines agrarii civitatis Groning. controversiam moverunt de quibusdā adjus stapulæ pertinentibus.
Delegati Ordinum Groningæ & Omlandiæ ad Regē Hispaniarum Gans[?]davi Anno 1559. Johan de Mepsche Johan Sickinge. Gert Horenken. Johā Rengers tē post Haye Westerwolt Secret. Eyb. Alting.

p.i: Pacta conventa inter partes intercef-fore Philippo Core-lio, de jure stapulæ.

page.notes: Names are printed in the order of the year groups; the year is shown on the first line of each group. Original spelling is kept where the printer varies it (Iohan, Vlger, Saffcher); initial I and V are normalised to J and U as rule 5 requires only in the cases where they are vowels or consonants. The marks at the left (a small star before 1560's Iohan Horenken and at 1561, and a small mark above the running head) are printed symbols, not page numbers; the star marks are recorded as notes. Greek and Hebrew: none. The signature "X 3" printed at the foot is visible on the scan and is not transcribed as text. Faint background text at the right edge is show-through and is omitted. <note side="left">Johan</note>
